Definition
[capacity and covering functions]

Source: petersen:page-0416 For compact $X$, write $\Cap (\varepsilon )=\Cap _X(\varepsilon )$ is the maximum number of disjoint $\varepsilon /2$-balls in $X$, and $\Cov (\varepsilon )=\Cov _X(\varepsilon )$ the minimum number of $\varepsilon $-balls needed to cover $X$.
